title: Verify recipe refusal after session restart
changes: Document that a checkpoint from an earlier control run remains inspectable but cannot dispatch into a reopened session.
validation: In an isolated EUR interpreter session, an owned recipe client was stopped during a wait after a completed step, the GUI closed normally, and the session reopened with a different control-run identity. The old checkpoint remained readable; resume was refused, checkpoint bytes and command-channel files stayed unchanged, the new guest state was unchanged, and both GUIs closed normally. Protected inputs stayed unchanged.
limitations: This verifies safe refusal across a normal close/reopen, not automatic cross-restart recovery or a runtime crash. Native Windows and physical input were not tested. Private session copies remain as a named current proof pending replacement.
